_readme: Sample Gate 0 sessions, shaped like the onboarding tables: messages, facts (source and status), checkpoints with sections, rubric results and questions. Facts inside checkpoint sections, topic coverage and the journey are CR-W18.

messages.text: Hi Javaris. I'm Canon. I'll ask one question at a time, twelve at most, then draft each checkpoint for you to approve. Who is this for, and what goes wrong for them today?
GTS Diesel's drivers. They get jobs by text from the dispatcher and lose track of them. Photos of finished work go over WhatsApp and never reach the office.
How will you know it worked? Pick the measure that matters most.
options: A driver finds the next job fast
Photos reach the office the same day
messages.answer: A driver finds the next job fast

messages.text: Dale said: “If a driver can't find the job in ten seconds, he'll call me instead.”
Is there an app or repo already, or does this start from nothing?
Their ops app, gts-diesel/ops-app. I've connected it read-only. The driver list is in the sheet I uploaded.
I've drafted 0.1, the brief, from your answers and the sheet. Two facts came from the sheet and are marked proposed until you approve.
Breakdown is drafting. One thing blocks the sign-in module: should drivers sign in with SMS codes or with company SSO?
messages.question: Q-0.2
messages.why: 40 of 62 drivers use personal phones, from the fleet sheet. SSO would add an identity-provider module.
ack: SMS codes it is. M1 now signs drivers in with a one-time code, and I’ve dropped the identity-provider work. 0.2 is no longer blocked.
Company SSO, then. I’ve added an identity-provider module to 0.2; I’ll need GTS’s SSO provider before 0.4.

messages.text: Two smaller ones for 0.2 while you’re here. Neither blocks it: should the old dispatch texts run alongside for a week?
messages.question: Q-0.2b
ack: A week of overlap. I’ve added it to M4 and kept the risk in 0.2 so we watch it.
Switch off at launch. I’ve added a launch-day notice to M4 and closed the overlap risk.

messages.text: And do drivers take a delivery photo at every stop, or only for damaged goods?
messages.question: Q-0.2c
ack: Only for damaged goods. M3 stays at 4 scenarios.
A photo at every stop. M3 gains the offline photo queue: 2 more scenarios, about a quarter of a module cap.

lines.t: A client project for GTS Diesel. Their contacts own the acceptance examples, and it ships to gts-diesel/ops-app.
Drivers get jobs by text and lose track of them. Photos of finished work go over WhatsApp and never reach the office.
62 drivers, 40 of them on personal phones, and 2 dispatchers.

sections.k: Outcome and how we'll measure it

lines.t: A driver finds today's next job in under 10 seconds.
The office has photos for every closed job the same day.
Today's jobs, job detail with photos, job status, a dispatcher board.
No invoicing, no route planning, no customer portal.
10 days from plan approval, the Feature package's deadline.
Works on 4G in the yard, on phones from 2019 on.
Signal is patchy at job sites, so photos must queue and send later.
Given a driver with 3 jobs today, when they open the portal, then the next job is first.
Given no signal, when a driver adds a photo, then it sends when signal returns.
How drivers sign in. Moved to 0.2 as a question for you.
Feature shipped: one scoped feature in an existing app, inside 10 days.

messages.text: Hi Javaris. I'm Canon. I'll ask one question at a time, twelve at most, then draft each checkpoint for you to approve. What's this project, and what goes wrong today?
Every field-service client asks for the same screens: today's jobs, a job page with photos, job status and an office board. I want one starter for it that new projects begin from.
Before anything else: is this a client project, or an internal template?
messages.question: Q-0.1a
messages.why: You described a starter that future field-service clients begin from, and no client is attached.
ack: An internal template, then. You're the client on this one: you write the acceptance examples, it ships to avel/templates, and once it's delivered with a verified receipt you can publish it to Templates. Next: which kinds of client should start from it first?
A client project, then. Which client? Pick one, or type a new name.
An internal tool, then: AVEL’s own software, built like a client project with you as the client. It ships to an AVEL repo. Next: what has to work on day one?

messages.question: Q-0.1b
messages.why: Your two most recent clients. Type a name to start a new one.
ack: GTS Diesel it is. Their rules and knowledge apply from here. Next: how will they know it worked?
Blume Studio it is. Their rules and knowledge apply from here. Next: how will they know it worked?
